source_refs.note: 1. Point Source Pollution: a main subheading of 33.2 Sources of Water Pollution, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 249-249.

blocks.text: Point-source pollution woh contamination (gandagi) hai jo water body (pani) mein ek hi, discrete (alag) aur identifiable (pehchani ja sakne wali) jagah se aati hai. Kyun ke sara ganda pani ek hi jagah gir raha hota hai, is liye wahan se pollution plume (pollution ki lambi dhaar) banti hai. Girne ki jagah par ya us ke foran aage (downstream) pollutant (jaise heavy metals ya organic waste) ki concentration sab se zyada hoti hai, aur wahan localized acute toxicity (usi jagah foran hone wala shadeed zehreela asar) hota hai. Misal: ek factory apne khaas pipe se lead ya mercury salts seedha darya mein daal rahi ho. Doosri misal: chemical plant ka storage tank leak ho kar pehle mitti mein aur phir zameen ke neeche ke pani (groundwater) mein ja raha ho.

blocks.alt: Aik bara concrete ka pipe gande pani (sewage) ki surmai dhaar pani ki naali (channel) mein gira raha hai; oopar aur kinare par samundari parinde (gulls).

blocks.long_description: Pollution aik identifiable (pehchani ja sakne wali) jagah se aati hai, is liye pipe ke foran neeche concentration sab se zyada hota hai.
